title: Machine Learning-Driven Nano-QSAR and Quantum Chemical Design of Functionalized 2D Borophene Nanocarriers for Alzheimer's Tau-Targeted Therapeutics
description: Fully reproducible computational pipeline and data archive for the study of pristine beta-12 borophene (B40H15) as a candidate carrier for Alzheimer's Tau-directed therapeutics. Includes: GFN2-xTB relaxed drug/borophene adsorption energetics for 29 ligands, resolving two regimes (12 chemisorb via covalent B-C/B-O bonds, Delta_E_int,SP -81 to -233 kcal/mol; 17 physisorb, -8 to -44 kcal/mol); a single seeded AutoDock Vina v1.2.7 docking run against the cryo-EM Tau paired-helical-filament core (PDB 5O3L) written directly into the master table; a leak-free nested 5x5 cross-validated RidgeCV surrogate with Y-scrambling and OECD Principle 3 applicability domain; and an end-to-end master script (run_entire_tau_study.py). The model-free chemisorption/physisorption dichotomy is the contribution; descriptor-based QSPR is weak for both endpoints. Every value in the manuscript is computed from this pipeline; no descriptor or energy is estimated from an empirical formula. v2.0.0 recomputes the adsorption set with relaxed complexes, repoints docking from 6VHL to the manuscript's 5O3L receptor with a corrected box, and seeds all stochastic steps.
